claude_proposed_widenings.name: set_roll_floor
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic sets a minimum value on the final total of certain roll kinds, pegged to the character's raw ability score (not the modifier). No existing atom expresses a conditional total-replacement rule: modify_roll_numeric is additive only, modify_roll_advantage picks the higher of two d20 rolls (not a floor on total), and set_ability_score acts on the score itself. A new atom is required: { kind: 'set_roll_floor', on: RollKind[], floor: { kind: 'ability_score', ability: Ability } }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If your total for a Strength check or Strength saving throw is less than your Strength score, you can use that score in place of the total.
